title: Beachfront Home w/ Pool 30A Florida Rental in Dune Allen
meta_description: Experience luxury at this 30A vacation rental, featuring stunning Gulf views and a spacious private pool complete with a privacy fence, outdoor TV, and ample seating. Enjoy an open concept living area, a fully stocked kitchen, and bicycles!
description_expanded: AboutProperty Highlights: • Large private pool, outdoor TV, ample seating, all surrounded by a privacy fence • Golf Cart - Savings! Add the Street Legal Golf Cart - 10% Discount off Cart Rate • Bikes! • Gulf views • Close to beach access! • Overlooks 30A! • Multiple balconies • Prime 30A location • Fully stocked kitchen for all your culinary needs • Open-concept living area perfect for gatherings • Four backpack beach chairs and a beach umbrella included • Free Wi-Fi throughout the home • Conveniently close to dining, shopping, and entertainment • Thoughtfully stocked with a Starbucks coffee pack, creamer, sugar, bottled water, and a starter amenity package, including essentials like paper towels, dish soap, laundry pods, and bathroom toiletries. Please note: The indoor fireplace is decorative only and intended for visual enjoyment. Welcome to Dune Daze – Your perfect 30A vacation rental! Located in the heart of Dune Allen Beach on 30A, this luxury vacation rental is a charming 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom beach house designed for relaxation and fun. Just steps from the pristine white sands, this 30A vacation rental sleeps 16 guests and is ideal for families and groups seeking a peaceful yet exciting retreat. Enjoy easy access to the Dune Allen Beach public entrance, with a quick stroll or bike ride to local favorites like Stinky’s Fish Camp, Shunk Gulley, and Gulf Place, a lively dining and shopping hub. With direct access to the 30A bike path, exploring the scenic coastline is a breeze. Upon arrival, you'll be greeted by a private pool with a privacy fence, perfect for cooling off after a day at the beach. Grill poolside on the gas BBQ or grab a refreshing drink from the nearby refrigerator. Whether you're watching the sunset from the wrap-around balcony or relaxing by the pool, every outdoor moment feels like paradise. The main living area on the third floor features an open-concept kitchen, dining, and living room with breathtaking Gulf views. With stainless steel appliances, a large breakfast bar, and multiple dining areas, it’s the ideal space for gathering and sharing meals. Also on the third floor is a queen-over-queen bunk room, perfect for kids or extra guests. On the second level, you'll find three well-appointed bedrooms: another queen-over-queen bunk room with individual flat-screen TVs, a queen bedroom with balcony access, and a spacious king suite with a sleeper sofa, en-suite bathroom, and private balcony. The fourth-floor bedroom is a private haven, complete with wrap-around balcony views, a Primary King Bedroom, Ensuite with Shower, and a wet bar with a mini-fridge and coffee maker. It's the perfect spot to enjoy the sunrise or sunset in complete serenity. Whether you’re planning a family vacation or a friends’ reunion, Dune Daze has everything you need for an unforgettable stay. Book your stay today and start creating lasting memories at this incredible 30A beach retreat.
